content.short: Monad is a high-performance, EVM-compatible L1 blockchain featuring parallel execution and 10,000 TPS.
content.description:
Monad is an ultra-high-performance, Layer 1 blockchain designed to provide the speed and scalability needed for the next generation of decentralized applications while maintaining full EVM compatibility. Unlike traditional sequential processors, Monad utilizes parallel execution to process multiple transactions simultaneously, targeting a throughput of 10,000 transactions per second with sub-second finality. This allows developers to port existing Ethereum dApps to Monad with zero code modifications while benefiting from significantly higher performance.

The network introduces several technical innovations, including MonadDb (a custom high-speed state database) and the MonadBFT consensus mechanism, to eliminate common blockchain bottlenecks. Monad serves as a foundational infrastructure for high-frequency DeFi, gaming, and social applications that require institutional-grade throughput and low transaction costs. Through its commitment to extreme performance and open-source development, Monad is building the essential framework for a more scalable and accessible decentralized economy.
